sentiment.label: risk_on
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 26,62 è in calo del 25,83% e si colloca nella fascia 18‑25, segnale di moderata volatilità. L'S&P 500 è in forte rialzo (+4,73%) e il FTSE MIB guadagna (+0,65%). Il DXY è leggermente più debole (-0,02%) e il Brent scende del 3,46%, riducendo la pressione inflazionistica. Questi dati, uniti a un M2 globale in espansione (+5,7% YoY USA) e a un flusso netto positivo nei BTC ETF (+3,8 M$), indicano un contesto di risk‑on nonostante la leggera pressione sul petrolio.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 26.62 fell 25.83% and sits in the 18‑25 range, indicating moderate volatility. The S&P 500 is up strongly (+4.73%) and the FTSE MIB gains (+0.65%). The DXY is marginally weaker (-0.02%) and Brent drops 3.46%, easing inflationary pressure. Combined with expanding global M2 (+5.7% YoY US) and a net inflow into BTC ETFs (+$3.8M), the picture points to a risk‑on environment despite the modest oil pullback.

Commodities: Brent -3,46% e oro -0,83% indicano pressione sui prezzi energetici e un sentiment misto per l’oro. Valute: DXY -0,02% suggerisce un euro leggermente più forte, supportato dal deposito BCE al 2,50%.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 +4.73% and FTSE MIB +0.65% drive indices higher; Euro STOXX 50 futures confirm a positive European start. Fixed Income: TLT up (+0.29%) while the US 10Y yield stays elevated at 4.91%, reflecting rate compression. Commodities: Brent down 3.46% and gold down 0.83% show pressure on energy prices and a mixed outlook for gold. Currencies: DXY down 0.02% points to a slightly stronger euro, underpinned by the ECB deposit rate at 2.50%.

The strike used jet-powered drones and cruise missiles reportedly guided through an airborne relay network rather than Starlink.
